description:
Activate Zameck Guildmage's first ability by paying {G}{U}, causing each creature you control to enter the battlefield with an additional +1/+1 counter this turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Grazing Kelpie, adding {C}{C}.
Grazing Kelpie dies, triggering its persist ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with no -1/-1 counters due to Zameck Guildmage.
Repeat from step 2.
